coverage.name: hello_world
coverage.scope: Compiled-control expected trace. Independent acceptance is exact text and source bitmap; the all-opcode suite separately checks instruction semantics.

image.scope: 64 KiB AT27C512R image; only 0000..3FFF is decoded as ROM. CPU reconstructs the unchanged graphics payload at 4000..payload_end, then jumps to 4000. FEF8..FEFA are CPU-initialized loader workspace. Physical programming/readback and actual device startup remain unverified.

coverage.scope: ROM-only initialization with deterministic poisoned SRAM. Every loader instruction is checked against the architectural oracle. Payload hash, exact SRAM write count and absence of loader IO/ROM writes are checked before application entry.
